name: trailer-571
title: Life Framework trailer
session: node agent-box/session.mjs up --clients 3 --mission playtest --profile full --res 1920x1080 --sound --wait --priority low
shootAfter: M2 polish and the #679 visual QA sweep. Every shot's `blockedBy` issues must be closed, or the shot swapped for its `fallback`.
note: The trailer storyboard. A shot with camera.pending cannot be shot yet (prose placement, or an actor setup nobody wrote); film-make lists and skips it. Shoot a location group with `toolscli film-make video/trailer-571.json --group spawn-square`. The trailer itself is gated: docs/marketing/trailer/quality-gate.md.

variants.name: vertical
variants.note: #571 asks for a 9:16 version. A 1080x1920 client window is untested (docs/film-pipeline.md). Every shot keeps its subject in the centre third so a 9:16 crop works from the 16:9 take.

lookDefaults.hourNote: agent-box/shots.mjs GOLDEN_HOUR (local hour) used for every gallery shot
lookDefaults.weatherNote: Clear only: #602 (clouds look goopy in DebugWorld) is open

cues.cue: hard hit on the title, 1 s silence
full track, cut on the bar

audio.game: process-loopback capture per take (#396): drill, sacks, coin, siren, CPR, crane. Under the music.
audio.vo: script.md lists every line with its TTS text. Kokoro or Piper (#397).

titles: script.md lists every caption and card. Lower third, 42 characters a line, two lines at most.
